title: Advanced RAG Architectures
description: Go beyond basic RAG with GraphRAG, RAPTOR, and ColBERT-style retrieval. Learn when each architecture wins and how to prove it with evaluation.
description_cs: Posuňte RAG na další úroveň s GraphRAG, RAPTOR a ColBERT-style retrievalem. Naučte se, kdy který přístup vyhrává a jak to dokázat evaluací.
learning_objectives: Decide when GraphRAG is worth the added complexity
Build a RAPTOR-style hierarchical retrieval pipeline
Compare dense retrieval, reranking, and late-interaction methods
Design multi-representation indexes for search vs generation
